# Atlas (2024 film) – Summary
"Atlas" is a science fiction film released by Netflix on May 24, 2024, starring Jennifer Lopez as Atlas Shepherd, an AI analyst with a deep mistrust of artificial intelligence stemming from her family’s connection to its creation. Set in 2071, the plot follows Atlas as she joins a military mission to a distant planet to hunt Harlan, a rogue humanoid AI terrorist who previously led a devastating war against humans. Atlas is forced to rely on an AI-controlled mech called Smith after her team is killed, and together they develop an uneasy alliance while fighting their way to stop Harlan from stealing carbon bombs and destroying Earth’s atmosphere. Ultimately, Atlas confronts her own guilt, defeats Harlan, and learns to trust AI, with Smith’s sentience implied to survive.
The film, directed by Brad Peyton and written by Leo Sardarian and Aron Eli Coleite, also stars Simu Liu, Sterling K. Brown, Abraham Popoola, Lana Parrilla, and Mark Strong. "Atlas" quickly became a streaming hit, reaching the #1 spot on Netflix in 71 countries and amassing 60 million global views by June 2024. Despite its popularity with viewers, critical reception was poor, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting a 19% approval rating and Metacritic a score of 37/100, citing an underwhelming script and unoriginal concepts. However, Lopez’s committed performance and the impressive visual effects received some praise. The film earned nominations at the Golden Reel and Golden Raspberry Awards.
